people.name: Sudhir Kumar Jha
people.role: Group Head - Legal & Group General Counsel
people.evidence_quote: Mr. Sudhir Kumar Jha, Group Head - Legal & Group General Counsel, has superannuated from the services of the Bank with effect from the close of business hours on September 30, 2026 and consequently has also ceased to be a Senior Management Personnel of the Bank.
people.tenure_quote: throughout his 22 years of association with HDFC Group (including Housing Development Finance Corporation Limited and the Bank).

people.name: Jigar Shah
people.evidence_quote: Mr. Jigar Shah, General Counsel – Designate will assume the position of General Counsel of the Bank in place of Mr. Jha, effective from October 1, 2026.
